scenarios.name: Float and redock the drawing browser

scenario_steps.name: a drawing document is active in the MCAD Software
its browser is docked to the left of the drawing
the user drags the browser header into the drawing area
the browser floats over the drawing sheet
the browser displays drawing resources and the sheet tree
the drawing remains visible behind the browser
the user drags the floating browser header to the left edge of the workspace
the browser docks at the left edge
the drawing remains visible in the remaining workspace
